description:
Priority: P1 (CI). File: .github/workflows/on-push.yml. Reference: keystore (clippy job), hare (pins).

Problem: Workspace clippy only runs deep inside the merge-queue ci-flow; PRs get no fast workspace-wide lint feedback. Pins are a major version behind, and there is no concurrency cancel.

Change:
  - Add a dedicated clippy job (`cargo make clippy-flow`) and add "clippy" to the push-time pr-ready.needs.
  - Bump actions/checkout@v4->v5 and actions/upload-artifact@v4->v7.
  - Add a concurrency block (safe on push only — never on the merge queue):
      concurrency:
        group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
        cancel-in-progress: true

Acceptance: a clippy violation fails the PR's "⚡ PR Ready" check; superseded push runs are cancelled.
Depends on: TPL-001 (guard already landed), TPL-006 (clippy-flow).
title: [TPL-009] Enhance on-push.yml (clippy job + concurrency + pin bumps)
